description: This file defines the 'Document' class which extends a 'File' class, representing documents in the system. It includes properties related to document metadata, methods for saving, retrieving summaries, filling in details, and managing relationships and exports. It also handles document versioning and deletion logic.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Represents a document entity extending the File class, with metadata properties, methods for persistent storage, relationship management, and exports, within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the save method to handle document revision creation, file copying, and relationship updates during save operations.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a short textual summary (the document's name).

methods.name: is_authenticated
methods.description: Checks if the document is authenticated based on internal property.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates additional list view fields based on revision and metadata.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fills in detailed metadata fields for display, including revision info, file URLs, and user info.

methods.name: list_view_parse_additional_sections
methods.description: Processes additional sections in list view; currently returns input unchanged.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query for exporting document data with custom joins and where conditions.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares an array of data for list view display, including URLs, revision info, and category labels.

methods.name: mark_relationships_deleted
methods.description: Removes relationship links and deletes associated revisions and files when a document is deleted.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates support for specific interfaces like ACL and FILE.

methods.name: get_document_name
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the document name by its ID from the database.
